strings.“Although” and “but” don't go together:: “Although”和“but”不能一起用：二选一（Although it is fast, it is large / It is fast, but it is large）。

strings.“between” for two things or clearly sepa: “between”用于两者或界限分明的几项；“among”用于一群。
strings.“can” and “be able to” mean the same: us: “can”和“be able to”意思相同：二选一（it can learn，或 it is able to learn）。
strings.“discrete” = separate, countable (discre: “discrete” = 离散的、可数的（discrete variables）；“discreet” = 谨慎得体的。
strings.“e.g.” = for example (one of several); “: “e.g.” = 例如（几个中的一个）；“i.e.” = 也就是（确切所指）。
strings.“every” and “each” go with one thing: ev: “every”和“each”后面接单数：every student, each result（动词也用单数：every student has）。
strings.“fewer” for things you can count (fewer: “fewer”用于可数的东西（fewer samples）；“less”用于不可数的量（less noise）。
strings.“its” means belonging to it (its accurac: “its”表示“它的”（its accuracy）；“it's”表示 it is 或 it has。
strings.“many” for things you can count (many sa: “many”用于可数的东西（many samples）；“much”用于不可数的量（much data）。
strings.“maybe” = perhaps (Maybe it works); “may: “maybe” = 也许（Maybe it works）；“may be”是动词（It may be faster）。
strings.“number of” for countable nouns (number: “number of”用于可数名词（number of users）；“amount of”用于不可数名词（amount of data）。
strings.“our method”, “its accuracy”, “their res: “our method”、“its accuracy”、“their results”：名词前的物主代词（my, your, its, our, their, his, her）表示它属于谁。
strings.“principle” = a rule or idea; “principal: “principle” = 原则、原理；“principal” = 主要的（principal component）。
strings.“quite” = fairly or very (quite fast); “: “quite” = 相当、很（quite fast）；“quiet” = 安静的。
strings.“than” compares (better than); “then” is: “than”用于比较（better than）；“then”表示时间或顺序（and then）。
strings.“that” starts a clause that defines the: “that”引导限定名词的从句（不加逗号）；“which”补充额外信息，前面通常有逗号。
strings.“their” = belonging to them; “there” = a: “their” = 他们的；“there” = 那里，或用于“there is/are”。
strings.“there” = a place, or “there is/are”; “t: “there” = 那里，或用于“there is/are”；“they're” = they are。
strings.“the” points to something specific or al: “the”指特定的或已知的事物；“a/an”引出众多之中的一个；泛指的复数名词和不可数名词前常常不加冠词（Models fail when…, Research shows…）。
strings.“this/that” go with a singular noun, “th: “this/that”接单数名词，“these/those”接复数名词：this result, these results。
strings.“too” = also, or more than enough; “to”: “too” = 也，或“太”；“to”是介词或不定式标记。
strings.“worth” takes the -ing form: it is worth: “worth”后面接 -ing 形式：it is worth noting, worth trying。
